text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Matikanefukukitaru shows up with quite a difficult request.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ummm… I don't suppose you would approve of me giving up on studying for this test, would you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I knew it. Fine. I just wanted to put it out there.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sigh… No way around this, huh? I suppose this calls for me to unleash my true power. Or even better yet, my spiritual power!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Grr… Ryaaah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What do you make of that, Trainer?! My power is so great, the cherry blossoms are all in full bloom…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?! Cherry blossoms?! Where did Trainer go?!
I'm glad you've made it, Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Is that… me?! What?! I didn't know I had a doppelganger!

text_block_list.name: Shiraoki (?)
text_block_list.text: It is I, Shiraoki. I have taken hold of your body as a way of manifesting myself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Shiraoki?! Uhh, what is going on right now?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait! Where are you going?! P-please, wait a moment!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… H-how did I end up racing against Shiraoki?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Uuugh… Of course the great Shiraoki would be this fast! But there's something different about me…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: My body feels so light!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Phew… To think I get to run with Shiraoki. It's a dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Shiraoki (?)
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Hold onto this feeling. Even after you awake, hold onto it…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: …Trainer… I think I'm finally awake.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: That's not what I mean! I've been awakened to a new power!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not entirely sure what she means, but her running is certainly improving!
